resources.string: Your pool looks at the sky. We adjust the chlorine according to the wind and heat of your city automatically.
Green water? Doubts? Ask our expert bot for free 24/7 and keep the water crystal clear.
The shield will remind you to test the electrical differential. Protect your family with quick checks.
Your data is never lost. Sync with your Google account and share access with anyone you want in real time.
APP programmed by Jose Manuel G \"LorenSoft\"
Hi! I\'m Blue Bot. What\'s happening with your pool?
You have used the trial version 30 times. To continue enjoying PISCINAS BLUE for life, make a maintenance donation.
Have you pressed the TEST button on the electrical panel and did the lever trip?
Remove the tablets, uncover the pool, and let the sun do its job. If you\'re in a hurry, drain 10% of the water and refill.
The water is alkaline. Use a \'pH Reducer\'. If you have waterfalls, turn them off for a while to let the level drop.
Alarm! 1. Adjust pH to 7.2. 2. Shock chlorine (granulated). 3. Brush walls. 4. Filter for 24 continuous hours.
Lacking filtration or there is lime. Backwash the sand filter and use \'Flocculant\' or \'Clarifier\' so the dirt sinks to the bottom.
Use diluted bleach at 1% for viruses. If it\'s just lime on the stone, white vinegar works wonders.
In Spain, program 70% from 00:00 to 08:00 (cheap electricity). The rest at noon to move the chlorine.
I recommend the \'Yieryi 7-in-1 WiFi\' on AliExpress or the \'Blue Connect\' on Amazon. They measure everything themselves.
The cheapest is the Venturi vacuum (€20). If you want comfort, the Wybot battery robot is the best value for money.
Use natural repellents (neem) for insects. If you use chemicals, make sure they dry before letting your pet pass.
Hi! I\'m Blue Bot, your pool expert. How can I help you today?
I\'m not sure I understand. Try: \'green water\', \'high chlorine\' or \'how to program filter\'.
Are you sure you want to close the application?
